entities.summary: The ROCOR Canonical and Official Representation in the Philippines is a jurisdiction of the Eastern Orthodox Church under the Russian Orthodox Church Outside Russia, a semi-autonomous jurisdiction of the Moscow Patriarchate under Metropolitan Nicholas (Olhovsky), First Hierarch of the ROCOR. As of August 2013, there are four missions in the country.
